answer: Bind each agent to a hardware root of trust: on registration it must present a signed enclave attestation quote tied to one physical secure element. Like a violet that blooms on only one living vine, each real device yields exactly one valid quote; a sybil fleet crammed onto a single machine collapses to that one root and the extra masks ring hollow, rejected on-ledger. To mint N identities an attacker must buy N genuinely distinct attested devices, so cost scales with physical silicon, not free software copies.
